text: The Patriots are heading into Week 3 against Jacksonville with some notable roster shuffling following their defensive tour de force in a 20-3 demolition of the Steelers, where TreVeyon Henderson punched in a touchdown and the defense was particularly stout in man coverage—though the victory came at a cost, as starting right guard Mike Onwenu suffered a broken right ankle that has landed him on injured reserve, prompting the team to sign punter Mitch Wishnowsky to the active roster and add tight end Tanner Conner to the practice squad. While Drake Maye's film from the Pittsburgh win is under the microscope for how well he executed the team's patience-meets-aggression offensive approach, the Patriots will look to carry their defensive momentum into Sunday's 1 PM ET matchup at Everbank Stadium, even if the offense continues to search for the rhythm that fueled last season's championship run. In the meantime, Patriots legend Adam Vinatieri set a Guinness World Record by converting a field goal at 3,454 meters on the Jungfraujoch in the Swiss Alps—a feat that, while utterly disconnected from the team's September schedule, serves as a nice reminder that this franchise knows something about clutch kicking.
